behavior: A participant in an explicit reported conditional event does not thereby become the actual speaker, assessor or decision maker.
Each cited original source is parsed separately; a later independently asserted corresponding event by the same actor can authorize it. Uncited or unrelated actors/events cannot.
Unknown neighboring identity, long modifiers or payloads require an entire unchanged cited clause rather than an inferred subject.
Source literal names stay opaque to grammar. No role strings become hotwords or canonical aliases.

A real bound voice can report its complete unchanged quote. Author identity does not authorize a different payload, plan, assessment or decision; source/index and real sentence boundaries are checked.
Converting a complete model numbered presentation into prose retains item sentence boundaries. It does not merge the next actor speech into the preceding conditional participant.

bounds.regex_compilation: One event regex per literal actor, reused across body and cited sources
